title: How to Deposit Money & Not Lose Cash in GTA 6
text:
How to deposit cash into your BuckMe account, find ATMs fast, and avoid locking away all your spending money in Grand Theft Auto VI.

In GTA 6, you cannot deposit cash from your phone—you have to use a physical ATM. Open the purple BuckMe app and select "ATM Finder" at the bottom to waypoint the closest terminal (or filter by "Personal" on the pause map). Best of all, ATMs let you transfer money straight from your safehouse stash into BuckMe Checking without driving home first.

WARNING: Money moved into Family Savings ("Buck Yourself" / Save for the Future $5,000 goal) is permanently non-withdrawable, though hitting Chapter 1 savings milestones unlocks vendor discounts and raises your Checking balance cap.
